headlines.text: That Saturday in 2024, Killswitch went straight to headlining on debut, appearing on Collision, rated 7.63 ? a solid showing. Christian Cage's newly renamed henchman Killswitch (formerly Luchasaurus) helped The Patriarchy nearly overwhelm FTR and Garcia, but Garcia stole a roll-up win over Nick Wayne to close the show.
On a Wednesday in 2021, back when Fenix & PAC & Moxley went straight to headlining on debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.26 ? a genuinely great match.

2023 brought us this moment: the AEW World Trios Titles was up for grabs as The Elite vs. Hardy, Kassidy & Page went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.85. It was the first title opportunity of Hardy, Kassidy & Page's career. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
